scope: Two previously exposed development tasks, six historical results, original versus generic-documentation prompts; twelve first-action slots. No contract elicitation, SQL/tool execution or training.

pricing.basis: Peak cache-miss rate; no cache-hit or off-peak discount assumed.
pricing.conditions: Twelve exact frozen prompts, maximum 512 output tokens each, no retries. Provider alias/count mismatch stops further calls after preserving the reply. Client timeouts do not establish provider cancellation.

execution_boundary.key_input: User's own terminal, hidden and memory-only; never use conversation keys.
execution_boundary.malformed_action: Retain INVALID_ACTION; do not repair, resample or discard.
execution_boundary.transport_timeout_or_interrupt: Stop batch; preserve dispatched/uncertain and remaining NOT_STARTED slots.
execution_boundary.date_change: Recheck prices and create a new preparation; do not alter this frozen snapshot.

covered: Literal paired intervention, deterministic order and no input mutation
Twelve-slot bound and no SQL/tool execution
Failure, keyboard interrupt, late response and token mismatch handling
No approval means no secret prompt
Official endpoint, no redirects, bounded child timeout and credential redaction

interpretation_limits: A documentation calibration, not a novel method or independent confirmation.
First cache reading is not itself correct or incorrect final reuse.
No direct measurement of task-interpretation drift.
Do not keep retuning documentation until desired behavior appears.
